response.note: A single query cannot prove causation, so this compares failed-attempt counts by failure category between the last two weeks (Oct 18-31) and the prior two weeks (Oct 4-17) to show which failure types grew most; it assumes the success status value is 'SUCCESS'.
response.sql: SELECT failure_category, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01') AS recent_failures, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-04' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18') AS prior_failures, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-04' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18') AS change_in_failures FROM v_attempts_clean WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-04' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01' AND status <> 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY failure_category ORDER BY change_in_failures DESC LIMIT 50
